def update_mutation_inputs(service):
    """
        Args:
            service : The service being updated by the mutation
        Returns:
            (list) : a list of all of the fields availible for the service. Pk
                is a required field in order to filter the results
    """
    input_fields = service.fields.all()
    input_fields.append(service.service_type.pk)
    input_fields.append(service.service_provider.pk)
    input_fields.append(service.service_status.pk)
    input_fields.append(service.service_category.pk)
    return input_fields
